1: Wow! Can I try? H-a-t… hat!
哇！我可以試試看嗎？H-a-t… hat（帽子）！
I found a big dog and a red box!
我找到一隻大狗和一個紅色的盒子！
You did it! Now we can read new words!
你們做到了！現在我們會讀新單字了！
2: Finn, a cat in a hat!
And a bat with a map!
還有一隻蝙蝠拿著地圖！
Look, a fan in my bag!
你看，我的袋子裡有一把扇子！
A, a, a — I hear it in every word!
3: Ruby, my pen is on the bed!
A red hen is on your leg!
有一隻紅色的母雞在你的腿上！
Oh no, now we are all wet!
糟糕，我們現在全身都濕了！
4: He can dig. Let's sit and watch!
牠會挖洞。我們坐下來看吧！
Six little pigs! Who will win?
The big one! Good job, pig!
5: Time for the spelling race! Cat, bat!
Bed, pen! I love short e!
A, e, i — we know them all!
6: Finn, a fox is in the box!
He can hop on top of the log!
Get the mop! Oh no, the fox ran!
快拿拖把！糟了，狐狸跑掉了！
7: Benny, the sun is up! Let's run!
Benny，太陽出來了！我們去跑步！
A bug is in my cup!
有一隻蟲在我的杯子裡！
Ha ha! Give me a hug, Ruby!
8: A big ship! Sh, sh, ship!
Look, a fish and a shell!
你看，一條魚和一個貝殼！
Let's shop for lunch. Cheese and chips!
我們去買午餐吧。起司和薯片！
9: Look, a gold ring! Is he a king?
你看，一個金戒指！牠是國王嗎？
Let's sing a long song for the duck king!
我們為鴨子國王唱一首長長的歌吧！
10: Fish, chip, duck, ring — sound teams!
Listen, the echo is singing with us!
聽，回音在跟我們一起唱！
11: Finn, look at the magic gate!
Say the magic word and we can play!
說出魔法字，我們就能進去玩！
Cake! Rain! Train! Did I say it right?
Yes! The gate is open. What a day!
12: 在那棵綠色的大樹上嗎？
Yes! Let's have tea and eat under it.
對！我們在樹下喝茶吃東西吧。
Then I will read you a story. E, e, e!
13: Finn, my kite can fly so high!
Look at the sky! I see five stars.
看天空！我看到五顆星星。
Nine now! The night is bright.
現在有九顆了！夜空好亮。
Let's ride my bike home. Good night!
我們騎腳踏車回家吧。晚安！
14: Coco, put on your coat. It's snowing!
My nose is cold! Let's take the boat.
我的鼻子好冷！我們搭船吧。
Slow down! The road is white.
Look — a rose in the snow. Let's go home!
你看——雪裡有一朵玫瑰。我們回家吧！
15: Welcome to the long vowel concert!
歡迎來到長母音音樂廳！
Bike, boat, snow — you sang them all!
16: Look at the moon! It's so blue tonight.
The zoo is open! Look at the cute animals.
動物園開門了！看那些可愛的動物。
Let's get food and jump in the pool!
我們去拿食物，然後跳進游泳池！
Oo, oo, oo — moon, food, zoo, pool!
17: Benny, look at the ice city!
So nice! Is that a gem?
Turn the page — the story is not over!
翻到下一頁——故事還沒完呢！
18: A bird and a girl are inside!
裡面有一隻鳥和一個女孩！
Turn here! There is corn for everyone.
在這裡轉彎！這裡有玉米給大家吃。
Ar, or, er — I can hear the r!
ar、or、er——我聽得到 r 的聲音！
19: Finn, what is in the treasure box?
Words! They are everywhere in books.
是單字！書裡到處都是它們。
Yes! You have to know them by heart.
20: The Sound Boss is here! Are you ready?
聲音魔王來了！準備好了嗎？
You did it! Sound Island is ours!
你做到了！聲音島是我們的了！
